facts.raw_span: A man in his early 60s with pathologic myopia
had undergone multiple procedures, including vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye for a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment 2 years previously
had received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections to the left eye for myopic choroidal neovascularization
Best-corrected visual acuities were 20/40 OD and 20/200 OS
Revealed emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye
Demonstrated the confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole
Color images of the left fundus
Spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing hyperreflective dots within a lamellar macular hole
En face swept source OCT showing oil bubbles within its boundaries

concepts.why: The patient had undergone multiple procedures, including vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye for a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment 2 years previously.
The patient had pathologic myopia and had received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections to the left eye for myopic choroidal neovascularization.
Multimodal imaging revealed emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye and en face swept source OCT showed oil bubbles within its boundaries.
En face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography demonstrated the confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole.
It explains the decreased best-corrected visual acuity in the left eye due to the presence of emulsified silicone oil in the fovea.

rationales.F02: History of vitrectomy and cataract surgery suggests previous retinal detachment
rationales.F03: Intravitreous ranibizumab injections are a common treatment for myopic choroidal neovascularization
rationales.F05: Emulsified silicone oil is a known complication of silicone oil use in vitreoretinal surgery
rationales.F06: Confinement of hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole is a characteristic feature of this condition
rationales.F08: Hyperreflective dots within a lamellar macular hole are a common finding in this condition
rationales.F09: Oil bubbles within the boundaries of a lamellar macular hole are a characteristic feature of silicone oil emulsification

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea and oil bubbles within a lamellar macular hole, as shown by multimodal imaging and en face swept source OCT, strongly supports Silicone Oil Emulsification as the primary diagnosis.
